$comment: Citation registry for the HHP+ / PhilPEN community NCD screening corpus. Only publicly resolvable sources belong here — kb_entries has no source column, so scripts/kb-load.mjs renders these into a 'Sanggunian / Source' line appended to both answer fields. Run `npm run kb:check-sources` before any demo. Sites behind a WAF (doh.gov.ph, foi.gov.ph) answer 403 to datacenter IPs and are marked wafBlocked — the checker warns instead of failing, and they must be eyeballed in a browser.
